record.category: currency exchange-rate API (fiat and crypto rates, conversion, VAT rates, IBAN validation, holiday calendars, central bank rates)

free_tier.stated: Free tier USD 0 per month: 200 requests per day (6,000 per month) and 30 requests per minute, 170+ fiat currencies and 500+ cryptocurrencies, real-time exchange rates, currency conversion, EU VAT rates, IBAN validation, public holiday and business-day calendars, central bank policy rates and CPI inflation; no historical data access.
free_tier.notes: Limits reset at 00:00 UTC; at the limit the API answers HTTP 429 with a reset timestamp and there are no overage charges. Historical rates, time series, precious metals and commodities are on Pro at USD 9 a month with 25,000 requests per day and 1,000 historical requests per day. A keyless widget endpoint on the same host is recorded separately.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-response cap is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API with no stored objects; the Free tier has no historical data access

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 200 requests a day bound what a free key can pull

record.interface_detail: GET https://api.unirateapi.com/api/{endpoint} (rates, convert, currencies, historical, vat, iban, calendar, macro) with the key in the api_key query parameter; JSON, XML or JSONP, with an OpenAPI document at https://api.unirateapi.com/apispec_1.json.
record.tooling: any HTTP client; code samples for Python, Node.js, Go, PHP and cURL
record.chaining: 200 requests a day of fiat and crypto rates with VAT, IBAN, holiday and central bank data but no history, so a free stack caches one rates call per refresh; the keyless widget endpoint of the same vendor serves rates at 60 requests a minute per IP, and history needs Pro or another source.

limits.value: 200 requests per day (6,000 per month) on the Free tier, reset at 00:00 UTC
30 requests per minute on the Free tier

record.limits_note: Plan gating: Free has no historical data access; historical rates, time series, precious metals, commodities, VAT number validation and market calendars are Pro. Bulk path: one rates call for a base returns a map of rates.
record.binding_note: 200 requests a day is met long before 30 per minute could be.

identity_cost.detail: The register page offers Sign up with Google or an email, a password and a password confirmation with a how-did-you-hear-about-us field; the pricing page says the Free tier needs no credit card.

record.reliability_note: At the limit the API answers HTTP 429 with a reset timestamp; a call with no key answered HTTP 401 Missing API key.
record.confidence_note: The tier, limits and features are read from the first-party pricing, home and forex pages, and a keyless call answered HTTP 401. A free key was not exercised, so the answer at the limit is unverified: behind a sign-up.

card.summary: Keyless endpoint at api.unirateapi.com/api/widget/v1: 60 requests per minute per IP with no API key, signup or credit card; rates refresh hourly.

record.category: currency exchange-rate API (keyless endpoint behind the embeddable widgets: rates, currencies, conversion, VAT rates)

free_tier.stated: Keyless endpoint at api.unirateapi.com/api/widget/v1: 60 requests per minute per IP with no API key, signup or credit card; rates refresh hourly.
free_tier.notes: The widgets page names this endpoint as the data source of its embeddable widgets. GET /widget/v1/rates?base=USD answered the full rate table for a base, fiat and crypto, as JSON; the widget script also calls /widget/v1/currencies, /widget/v1/convert and /widget/v1/vat/all. The keyed Free tier of the same vendor is recorded separately.

per_object_cap.stated: no cap is stated; one rates answer for the base USD was 21969 bytes of JSON

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API with no stored objects; the widget calls serve current rates, currencies, conversions and VAT rates

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; 60 requests a minute per IP bound what an address can pull

record.interface_detail: GET https://api.unirateapi.com/api/widget/v1/rates?base=USD, /widget/v1/currencies, /widget/v1/convert?amount=&from=&to= and /widget/v1/vat/all with no key; JSON answers carrying x-ratelimit-burst-limit, x-ratelimit-burst-remaining and x-ratelimit-burst-reset headers.
record.tooling: any HTTP client; the embeddable widget script at unirateapi.com/lander/static/js/unirate-widgets.js calls the same routes
record.chaining: Keyless current fiat and crypto rates for any base at 60 requests a minute per IP, so a free stack can refresh a rate table hourly without a key; history, time series and metals need the keyed Pro tier of the same vendor or another source.

limits.value: 60 requests per minute per IP, with no authentication; past it the endpoint answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After

record.limits_note: Current data only: the widget routes cover rates, currencies, conversion and VAT rates, with no history route.
record.binding_note: The only limit stated is 60 requests a minute per IP.

identity_cost.detail: No key, signup or card: the widgets page says the widget pulls rates from the public endpoint with no key, and a keyless GET answered HTTP 200 with a rates table.

record.reliability_note: Past the per-minute limit the endpoint answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After 20; it is documented as the data source of the embeddable widgets rather than as a general API, and refreshes hourly.
record.confidence_note: The keyless HTTP 200 answer, its size, the burst limit of 60 in its headers and the HTTP 429 answer past it are measured; the hourly refresh and the intended use are read from the widgets page.
